rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the hamburger sandwich.

example.english: I want a hamburger without onions.
example.traditional: 我想要一個漢堡包，唔要洋蔥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 go3 hon3 bou2 baau1 m4 jiu3 joeng4 cung1

rows.note: Use this shorter form for the sandwich when the context is clear.

example.english: A hamburger is fine for lunch.
example.jyutping: ng5 caan1 sik6 hon3 bou2 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the patty sold or used as part of a hamburger.

example.english: Could you fry the hamburger patty a little more?
example.traditional: 可唔可以幫我將塊漢堡扒煎香啲？
example.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 faai3 hon3 bou2 paa4 zin1 hoeng1 di1

rows.note: Use this generic term for the meat patty when the hamburger context is already clear.

example.english: I’ll save the hamburger patty for tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 lau4 faan1 faai3 juk6 beng2 ting1 jat6 sik6
